name: The World is a Theatre
description: There are n boys and m girls attending a theatre club. To set a play "The Big Bang Theory", they need to choose a group containing exactly t actors containing no less than 4 boys and no less than one girl. How many ways are there to choose a group? Of course, the variants that only differ in the composition of the troupe are considered different. Perform all calculations in the 64-bit type: long long for С/С++, int64 for Delphi and long for Java.
input_specification: The only line of the input data contains three integers n , m , t ( 4 ≤ n ≤ 30, 1 ≤ m ≤ 30, 5 ≤ t ≤ n + m ).
output_specification: Find the required number of ways. Please do not use the %lld specificator to read or write 64-bit integers in С++. It is preferred to use cin, cout streams or the %I64d specificator.
approach_summary: Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to N using Fermat's Little Theorem (mod 10^9+7 or 998244353). Answer nCr queries in O(1) time per query.
